resources.string: Shows NEXUS Recent Apps when you press the square button.

NEXUS uses this to show its own Recent Apps screen when you press the square (recent apps) button, and to notice which apps you open so they appear there. It never takes pictures of your screen: Recent Apps cards are made from each app's icon.

If you switch on the NEXUS lock screen in NEXUS settings, it also shows that screen when your phone's screen turns on (your phone's own PIN, pattern or fingerprint still unlocks it).

When you swipe apps away in NEXUS Recent Apps, NEXUS closes them fully for you: Android only lets the phone's own recent apps screen do that, so NEXUS briefly opens it behind its own screen and presses Close on those apps' cards (and on any app still open there that NEXUS Recent Apps doesn't show, so the two always match). That is the only screen NEXUS reads, and only while closing apps (you can switch this off in NEXUS settings → Recent apps helper). If you switch on NEXUS buttons in all apps (NEXUS settings), it also shows NEXUS's Back, Home and Recent buttons in place of the phone's own while you use apps: to do that it checks where the phone's own button bar is on screen, and the buttons only press Back, Home or Recent. NEXUS never reads, types or taps anything in your apps.

You can turn this off at any time here, or in NEXUS settings.
